items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And Peg Top, the guy, the guy they called Peg Top, he was a great piano player.

ctx.x: Oh, he got around all right though.

He got around, he was a good piano player. He used to play around Oakdale, the Louisiana, and the Quince. He was up there. We have a great piano player who lived in Beaumont, if he's not dead, they called Lee Johnson, David Lee Johnson. And Peg Top, the guy, the guy they called Peg Top, he was a great piano player. And around Chicago, we used to have a lot of good blues pickers around here too, you know. Forty-Five, the guy, his name was Forty-Five, and Albert Ammon.
